Customer feedback · Reporting

NPS Reporting

We shipped a service that turns thousands of open-text survey comments into themes and sentiment for existing reports.

evoke · 2025

The problem

Customer comments were already flowing into the business. Teams needed a consistent view of what people were saying, and they wanted to keep using the dashboards and processes they already had.

The decision

We defined a shared list of themes so results could be compared over time. A Node.js service processed comments in batches and returned structured results for the data team to write back to Snowflake.

What we shipped

The service fed existing Power BI reporting. We also designed for retries, failure tracking and cost monitoring, with responsibilities defined across the AI, data and reporting teams.
